The recent discovery of 10 hypervelocity stars (HVSs; Brown et al. 2005; Edelmann et al. 2005; Hirsch et al. 2005; Brown et al. 2006a,b, 2007) has raised many questions about their nature and origin.

Motivated by the lack of vsini and stellar parameter measurements for most of the known HVSs and the possibility of testing the nature of the SMBH in the center of our Galaxy, we performed high resolution spectroscopy of two HVSs.
